date.as_written: nabhorasābdhyaikamite śakebde saṃvatsare caiva parābhaākye ṛtau śarannāmni karāhvayetho sadosvije māsi ca somavāre ādimāyāṃ tithau caiva site pakṣe ca vaidhṛtau

notes: The scribe is described as the son of Jogadeva (jo(ga)devasya sūnunā); his own personal name is not preserved in the quoted portion, though the catalogue tentatively suggests Rāmeśvarabhaṭṭa (perhaps from line 10, which is omitted here). 'prayoga' may be a corruption for 'prayāge' (at Prayāga).
